note: Pastor Cole explicitly approved all 21 titles in list 2026-09-07-v1 for the app on September 7, 2026. Approval applies to these individual books; it does not authorize deployment or approve every work by their authors. Descriptions summarize public publisher or ministry information, and reader and difficulty labels are editorial judgments. The source checks confirm metadata and stated subject matter, not a full theological review.
